rows.note: Use this for a person who is worldly-wise or sophisticated, often with a slightly calculating or jaded shade.

example.english: They have seen it all and are very worldly.
example.traditional: 佢見慣大場面，做人好世故。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 gwaan3 daai6 coeng4 min2 zou6 jan4 hou2 sai3 gu3

rows.note: Use this when worldly means seasoned and experienced, rather than specifically worldly-wise or jaded.

example.english: They have been in business for years and are very worldly.
example.traditional: 佢做生意好多年，處事十分老練。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 hou2 do1 nin4 cyu2 si6 sap6 fan1 lou5 lin6

rows.note: Use this for earthly or worldly matters in contrast with spiritual matters.

example.english: These worldly concerns of fame and money do not matter to them.
example.traditional: 呢啲世俗嘅名利，對佢嚟講唔重要。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sai3 zuk6 ge3 ming4 lei6 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 m4 zung6 jiu3
